notes.title: Join the First Blood Tournament!
notes.content:
[img]http://slitherine.com/files/spotlight/773_image.jpg[/img]

We have great news for all Heroes of Normandie fans. As you might be aware, the developers have been working on integrating the Slitherine Tournament System. We’re now ready to run the [b]first tournament ever for Heroes of Normandie![/b]

It’ll be the first tournament of its genre for Heroes of Normandie, ever. We hope it will be a smooth experience for everyone, and if we encounter any bug we’ll be sure to squash them.

Three rounds, ten days each. The tournament will start next Monday, so don’t forget to join by clicking [url=http://slitherine.com/tournaments/tournaments.asp]here[/url].

The First Blood Tournament starts next Monday, and after thirty days we’ll know who is the Slitherine Heroes of Normandie champion!

notes.title: Heroes of Normandie - 1.60 patch!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

we are releasing the 1.60 update for [b]Heroes of Normandie![/b]

It's quite a big patch as it marks the update to Unity 5. As we announced before, this was a necessary change for updating the game's ranking system.

You can find the changelog down below.


[b]Changelog:[/b]
- Upgraded core engine to Unity 5
- Transferred backend from Parse to new servers
- Some sections in the editor were not working properly
- Fixed some typos in the labels
- Fixed a bug which caused the briefing dialogue to freeze in some cases’
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: 21st Panzer Division is out!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.slitherine.com/files/spotlight/560_image.jpg[/img]

The hit [b]Heroes of Normandie[/b] gets richer with the release of its latest DLC, [b]21st Panzer Division.[/b] 

This expansion adds [b]20 new units, a new hero, several new unit abilities, new mechanics such as the firing arc, and more, all for the mighty Wehrmacht![/b] 

[b]Heroes of Normandie[/b] is an extremely fun game, a digital adaptation by the popular boardgame with the same name by Devil Pig Games. The developers Cat Rabbit are working hard to constantly improve the game and add more features: 21st Panzer Division is yet another step in that direction.

The expansion is now out on Steam!

http://store.steampowered.com//app/502510

notes.title: A new DLC for Heroes of Normandie: the 21st Panzer Division is coming!
notes.content:
There had been rumours circulating (well, it was even in the patch notes!): yes, a new DLC for [b]Heroes of Normandie[/b] is coming, and yes, it’s going to be amazing.

Starting from August 30th you’ll be able to lead the fearsome 21st Panzer Division and throw those yankees back into the sea from where they came. The expansion comes with 20 new units, a new hero, several new unit abilities, and much more!

It will be released on [b]August 30th[/b] on PC and iOS.

notes.title: Heroes of Normandie 1.50 Patch!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are releasing a new patch for Heroes of Normandie today. Hopefully you will enjoy it. There’s a lot of interesting tweaks and changes, and you can read about them in the changelog below!

Changelog:[/b]

1. Added a new language: you can now play HoN in Russian!
2. Added a new RULES section in the game wiki, also available in-game (via the RULES HELP button)
3. Changed the first American campaign into a complete tutorial. Rules like Ambushing, Tripoding and Action Cards are now explained.
4. Action Cards can now be zoomed-in in any section of the game (in the discard phase, for example).
5. Action Cards don’t pop-up anymore when you hover with the mouse cursor. You have to click to bring them up and click again to use them. This improvement was suggested by many players in the forum.
6. Increased the maximum zoom-out distance by adding two new zoom levels.
7. Improved the way Recruitment Options and Tiles are presented in the Purchase section. They are now categorized by DLC.
8. Added a preview of the Panzergrenadiers DLC, as a “Coming Soon” purchase.


Bugfixing:
1. Added a Summary screen at the end of the Tutorial section. 
2. Fixed the victory condition for the Multiplayer Mission “A long way”
3. Fixed a bug in the carry-over mechanism that in some cases blocked the Rogue campaign.
4. Improved the aspect ratio of the units in the Game Editor (some vehicles appeared stretched-out).
5. Fixed a small number of minor bugs.

notes.title: The Heroes of Normandie New Actions Cards are here!
notes.content:
[b]Heroes of Normandie[/b] receives a [b]major free update[/b] with the addition of a new brand feature: the [b]action cards![/b]

The[b] new Action Cards[/b] significantly improve the gameplay and add a new layer of depth to the game.  There are[b] 29 new cards for Germany[/b] and[b] 32 for the US[/b], all of them tested and balanced through months of beta testing. They are accompanied by a patch including many bug-fixes, balance changes and[b] five new multiplayer missions[/b].

With this wonderful free update comes a [b]34% discount[/b] on the game on Steam starting at 7pm CET for the duration of seven days!

[b]Heroes of Normandie[/b] brings players in a colorful, digital boardgame experience, characterized by all the crazy characters from the three different armies (USA, Germany and The Commonwealth). 6 campaigns, a skirmish mode, 2 Rogue-like campaigns and a multiplayer mode where players can select pre-set forces or assemble their own army.

notes.title: Heroes of Normandie Action Cards are in Public Beta on Steam!
notes.content:
[b]Heroes of Normandie,[/b] after the  release of the first DLC US: Rangers, is reaching a new milestone!

Starting today, players will have the chance to try a long waited feature: the [b]Action Cards![/b]

This element will allow you to alter significantly the game style, granting you more challenges than ever!

Here's a brief list of the new features:

•	28 German cards
•	31 US cards
•	Cards can be played against the AI and in Multiplayer
•	The AI proficiency in using the cards depends on the difficulty level
•	[b]More cards to come![/b]

To activate the Beta and to unlock the Cards, you have to go to your Steam Library where Heroes of Normandie is listed among your other games. Right click on Heroes of Normandie and select “Properties” and then click on “Betas”. Select “beta-open beta” from the dropdown list in that beta tab to download the Beta.

[i]Click on the screenshots to enlarge them![/i]

[url=http://www.matrixgames.com/amazon/Screenshots/HoN/HoN_Cards/1.png][img]http://www.matrixgames.com/amazon/Screenshots/HoN/HoN_Cards/1a_sized.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Heroes of Normandie: US Rangers is released!
notes.content:
[i]“Rangers lead the way”[/i] – Rangers’ motto

All right gents! This no time for sitting back, and if you thought the fight was over, well,  I tell you: you thought wrong.

[b]Heroes of Normandie: US Rangers[/b] – the first expansion of one of the most recent and innovative tactical wargames around has been released, featuring a precious addition for  American Player: the [b]US Rangers[/b], the toughest among the toughest warriors!

From the Product Page:

” These tough soldiers are an invaluable asset and a sure threat to Jerry thanks to their love of the assault! Many of these brave soldiers have enhanced combat stats that reflect their harsh selection and training under [b]Captain Pepper!”[/b]

Not even the panzers can save the Germans this time!

To better celebrate this milestone, a completely [b]free new feature has been added[/b], available both to the base game and the expansion, finally introducing for single player and multiplayer alike, [b]the Editor!
[/b]
Learn how to create a mission in [b]less than 5 minutes[/b] with this [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3v39LBh_xTk&feature=youtu.be]beautiful video![/url]

www.youtube.com/watch?v=3v39LBh_xTk&feature=youtu.be

Check the changelog [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/365890/discussions/0/494632338493822913/]here[/url]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/421100/

notes.title: Editor Announced! And a surprise
notes.content:
The Normandy Campaign as you never seen it! After the extraordinary success of Heroes of Normandie, Developer Cat Rabbit is ready to roll out more content! 

[b]A new and much anticipated feature will soon be released: the Editor![/b] You will finally have the opportunity to set up a fully customizable battlefield, with different kinds of terrains and units, in single and multiplayer battles alike!

Want to have a first look at it? Just check the video we made especially for the occasion:
https://youtu.be/3v39LBh_xTk

But good news are not over! 

The first DLC of the series is also incoming: it will deploy US Rangers, featuring a punch board with twenty-nine new tiles for the US army and a new hero, the indomitable Captain Pepper! 
Versatile and brave, the US Rangers are assault units, preferring to close the distance with the enemy to unleash the massive firepower of the mighty United States Army! 

Guided by their legendary commander, they can’t wait to break Fritz’s defences, granting hundreds of hours more of pure fun! 

Brace yourselves! The DLC and the Editor will land on [b]December 15th[/b] on our stores and on Steam!

notes.title: Heroes of Normandie has been updated Version 1.12!
notes.content:
Hi all!

This new update adds the new HOTSEAT section!

Take a look on the changelog below!

[u]Version 1.12 Patch notes[/u]

•	New section: added the new HOTSEAT section, that allows to play multiplayer scenarios on the same PC
•	Interface new feature: Added a new tooltip that highlights the button that explains the ‘units stats’ 
•	Interface new feature: Autonomous ability: autonomous units are no more automatically selected as first during the activation phase. 
•	Interface new feature: Sniper ability: the game interface now correctly shows the die roll modifiers (LOS penalties) 
•	Interface new feature: Perforating ability: the game interface now correctly shows the ‘perforating’ die roll modifier 
•	Interface new feature: The game interface now shows the current turn number in the Order Phase.
•	Interface new feature: it is now possible to Cancel an assault.
•	Rule adjustment: as in the board game, Rex doesn't stop LoS anymore 
•	Rule adjustment: as in the board game, the KillShot rule is in the board game 
•	Rule adjustment: Suppressive Fire is now easier: LoS penalties are not doubled (this follows the board game rules)’
•	Bugfix: corrected the damage marker message 
•	Bugfix: corrected the suppressed marker display at the start of every new turn

notes.title: Heroes of Normandie Version 1.11 available! Different Difficulty Levels introduced!
notes.content:
It’s time to come back to the French countryside as Heroes of Normandie has been updated to Version 1.11!

This patch not only refines the game in many  ways, fixing bugs and little glitches (like an error on the 4th German Army in Skirmish Mode, which had a recruitment option assigned to the wrong slot), but also introduces 5 new Difficulty Levels, allowing you to play the game balanced for you:

[url=http://www.slitherine.com/img/HoN_diff_select.jpg][img]http://www.slitherine.com/img/HoN_diff_select.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Here there is the complete list of changes:[/b]

•	Introduced 5 levels of difficulty. The "Major” level is equal to the old “IronMan” option. The other difficulty levels make things easier for the player by providing different advantages
•	Added 3 new maps for Multiplayer
•	Fixed a glitch which could prevent some modifiers to be shown in the right bar during an assault
•	Fixed a bug which could prevent the login window to show up
•	Fixed a bug which caused a crash in the End Mission window of the Rogue Campaign
•	Fixed a bug which could produce incorrect Line of Sight for some squares near bridges
•	Fixed a bug on the 4th German Army in Skirmish Mode, which had a recruitment option assigned to the wrong slot
•	Changed the main objective of mission “Sitting Ducks”: it no longer a requirement  to be alone in the areas to occupy them

Grab the game [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/365890/]here[/url]

notes.title: Heroes of Normandie Patch 1.06
notes.content:
Hi guys,

the patch is out now. It includes a number of bug fixes, sorts out the issues with logging in to multiplayer and adds a new play mode. The original dice rolling model is now renamed Iron Man mode. You can turn this on in the options but it is off by default. There is a new random generator that will make it easier for new players to get to grips with the rules before they put themselves at the will of the dice gods! 

1.06 Change Log
* Fixed a bug that prevented the correct display of the leaderboard.
* Fixed a bug that caused the system to call the multiplayer server too often and bring down the servers. It also prevented logging in for some users.
* On the game launcher there is a Settings button. This lets you select your resolution and should resolve any 21:9 resolution issues. 
* Some external game controllers were causing issues and creating odd mouse input commands. We've improved this so less users are affected but let us know if it still affects you. 
* You can now scroll diagonally with the keyboard controls. 
* All skirmish maps are unlocked from the start. 
* Fixed an AI bug that caused the game to lockup/freeze. 
* Fixed a bug in the appearance of the German Fire Unit’
* It now auto saved in skirmish mode 
* added Iron Man Mode, and defaulted to having it off. Players should not experience runs of bad luck as the chance of this happening has been vastly reduced. 

The team are still working hard on a range of improvements so keep your feedback coming. We're especially interested to hear what you think about the new dice rolling system. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: The Flare Path: Scratch One Summer
notes.content: A flurry of local airshows and BoB commemorative events meant Spitfires and Hurricanes were regular visitors to my corner of Southern England this summer. Seeing six Messerschmitt maulers fly over in formation on September 15 really should have been my aviation highlight of the season, but that accolade actually goes to an encounter a few days earlier when, tramping along a Wiltshire footpath, I was repeatedly buzzed by a P-40 intent on entertaining crowds at a nearby display. The sound of a Merlin in full spate is a wonderful thing, but the whistle-threaded roar of Lulu Belle’s supercharged Allison V-12 left me beaming like a lottery winner. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Heroes of Normandie is out today with a Stream!
notes.content:
[i]“To a New Yorker like you, a Hero is some type of weird sandwich, not some nut who takes on 3 Tigers”[/i] – Oddball, in Kelly’s Heroes

Listen up soldiers! Let me refresh your empty brains on what is happening! A game like no other has been released today. It’s engaging, fast-paced, with big explosions, and it can provide you a real challenge with four gameplay modes.

And, most important of all, the good guys and the bad guys are perfectly recognizable so you dunces don’t risk shooting each other!

[b]The wait is finally over![/b] The PC adaptation of the famous board game [b]Heroes of Normandie[/b] is out and is ready to blow your mind!

In this stunning turn based strategy game you will command small group of gallant soldiers in tough fights through dense French countryside in six distinct campaigns against the AI or another human opponent in furious multiplayer battles! [b]Heroes of Normandie[/b] comes with multiple game modes including campaign mode, rogue campaign, skirmish and multiplayer. 

Customize your Army with a wide set of units with specific equipment , deploy powerful Heroes, give your orders on the battlefield and lead your men to victory!


[b]Watch our stream today at 20:00 CEST / 18:00 UTC / 2:00 PM EDT on our official [url=http://www.twitch.tv/slitherinegroup]Twitch Channel![/url][/b]

Heroes of Normandie is available also through on [url=http://www.humblebundle.com/store]Humble Bundle Store[/url] (starting from 7pm CEST / 5pm UTC / 1pm EDT)

notes.title: The Flare Path: Now Even Harrier
notes.content:
Swift sequels make The Flare Path uncomfortable. When I see a flight sim follow-up like Combat Air Patrol 2 set to arrive a mere 23 years after its predecessor, I find myself wondering how much genuinely new content will be included. Yes, the engine, feature set, and premise look totally different, and Sim155’s commitment to dynamic campaigns and intermediate ‘IL-2 level’ realism sounds right up my bomb alley, but that preposterously tight 276 month development cycle surely means corners have been cut.
